“Lotus Eaters” was finished by June 5th 1917 (Ellmann, R. James Joyce, p. 416).

On Joyce’s method, Ellmann writes: ‘His method was to write a series of phrases down, then, as the episode took form, to cross off each one in a different coloured pencil to indicate where it might go’.
